newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner seals oilfield deal with Statoil.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner seals oilfield deal with Statoil.

text.p: Anglo-Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner ASA said on Monday it had signed a final contract with Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) for development of the Siri oilfield.

Kvaerner announced in February that it had signed a letter of intent with Statoil for engineering, procurement, construction and installation of a production platform for Siri, which lies in the Danish sector of the North Sea.
The platform will comprise a jack-up unit with production facilities and living quarters placed on a steel storage tank standing on the seabed.
The field is expected to come on stream in late 1998.
